guards.guard: og-3: no preposition here has a default sense; a one-preposition-one-gloss reading is the error this unit exists to block
og-4: sense selection and case assignment are separate — genitive is invariant across every sense and no row emits a case claim
the paraphrase test is SUPPLIED evidence; the consumer never runs it and never treats an unrun test as a weak positive
the contested comitative-vs-transitivising environment preserves both readings; the source's own assignment is not adopted as fact
the sense lists are teaching inventories, not the classical ones; no-survivor means unlisted here, never ill-formed
expletive and lexically selected occurrences are out of scope and are never given a compositional sense
method transfers, conclusions do not: a sense resolved for one occurrence never projects to the next occurrence of the same preposition
